notes: v3.0.41 - The Retry failed histories button now finishes the job: athenaOne refuses to render chart panes in a background tab, so retried visit bodies used to fail the same way forever. Because you are present when you click retry, MLS Assist now brings the athenaOne tab forward just for that read and then puts you back exactly where you were - success or failure. Everything from v3.0.40 remains: schedule-keyword surnames import completely even welded into duration/age text, empty days must prove they settled, updated extensions self-heal open tabs, phantom rows can never stand in for dropped patients, note-write verification refuses unchanged/truncated/foreign landings with clean rollback, and charts up to 160k characters complete. Requires Chrome 116+.
